verdict.rationale: Slack offers real hooks for AI-native operation: Slackbot answers natural-language requests ('Update deals just by asking Slackbot'), AI search/summarization, and an official MCP server letting AI agents send messages, manage files/canvases/lists via natural-language-driven tool calls. However, most of this is vendor-documented rather than independently verified, and the MCP endpoint requires auth/setup rather than being a turnkey NL interface for end users.
